i.norm: Verifies that the default US-English {@link Soundex} encoder matches the behavior documented by Microsoft SQL Server for its {@code SOUNDEX} function.

All common spelling variations of the surname "Erickson" should encode to the same Soundex code "E625".

This mirrors the example published for the MS SQL Server {@code SOUNDEX} function (Microsoft Knowledge Base article Q100365).

@throws EncoderException if encoding any of the spellings fails
Every spelling below is expected to produce the code above.
